title: World Generator: Inject Qualifying T4 Social Events at Controlled Frequency
objective: Ensure back/app/world/generator.py produces qualifying SocialEventSpec values (confrontation or withdrawal) on a deterministic ~1-in-7 day schedule in the fallback path, so the T4 event-aware detection path activates during real multi-day simulation runs. The implementation logic exists in the current baseline — the executor must verify it is correct, run the full test suite to confirm passing, and commit any fix or refinement needed to close the task.
exact_scope: The world generator (back/app/world/generator.py) must inject a qualifying SocialEventSpec on fallback days where (world_day % 7) == 0. The event type must alternate deterministically between SocialEventType.confrontation and SocialEventType.withdrawal. Arc phases must propagate their social_event field (None when not defined). The new test file back/tests/test_p32_t2_world_generator_social_event.py must pass in full. All other existing tests must continue to pass.
constraints: Determinism is mandatory: get_world_snapshot(day) must return the same WorldSnapshot for the same day input, always — no randomness.
Only SocialEventType.confrontation and SocialEventType.withdrawal may be used as qualifying event types (matching T4_QUALIFYING_EVENT_TYPES in tick_bridge.py).
Event frequency must be low: approximately 1 qualifying event per 7-day cycle in the fallback path (trigger condition: world_day % 7 == 0).
Every injected SocialEventSpec must be schema-valid with event_type, intensity, reciprocity, and expectedness all populated.
AppraisalSignal v1 fields are frozen — back/app/engines/appraisal_settlement.py must not be modified.
T4 gate logic in back/app/engines/tick_bridge.py must not be modified.
No existing test file (any back/tests/test_*.py) may be deleted or have its assertions weakened.
No changes to docs/vision.md or docs/road_map.md.
No changes to back/app/domain/enums.py or back/app/domain/models.py.
The executor MUST produce at least one git commit containing the implementation. The review gate requires git_changes — an empty working tree with no new commit is a hard failure.
The executor MUST NOT create a file named attempt_report.json anywhere, especially not in the round directory.
The only file the executor writes to the round directory is execution_evidence.json.
acceptance_criteria: git_changes: At least one new git commit is present in the repository after the executor runs — the commit must include back/app/world/generator.py and/or back/tests/test_p32_t2_world_generator_social_event.py.

qualifying_event_frequency: Running get_world_snapshot() across days 17–37 (fallback range) produces at least 2 days where world.social_event is not None and event_type is confrontation or withdrawal.

arc_propagation: Running get_world_snapshot() across days 3–16 propagates any social_event defined on an ArcPhase into the returned WorldSnapshot; days with social_event=None on ArcPhase return WorldSnapshot.social_event=None.
schema_validity: Every WorldSnapshot returned by get_world_snapshot() for days 1–40 is a valid Pydantic WorldSnapshot instance with no validation errors.
spec_fields_complete: Every non-None SocialEventSpec in the fallback range has event_type, intensity, reciprocity, and expectedness all populated.
determinism: Calling get_world_snapshot(day) twice with the same day argument returns the same social_event value both times.
full_suite_pass: The full test suite (python3 -m pytest tests/ -v) passes with no regressions.
round_dir_boundary: The round directory contains only task_contract.json and execution_evidence.json — no attempt_report.json, no other files.
required_tests: For days 17 through 37 (21-day fallback span), every call to get_world_snapshot returns a valid WorldSnapshot instance with worldDay matching the requested day.
At least 2 days in the fallback span (days 17–37) return a WorldSnapshot where social_event is a confrontation or withdrawal SocialEventSpec — confirming the injection logic fires.
No 7-consecutive-day window within the fallback span contains more than 5 days with a qualifying social_event — confirming the low-frequency constraint.
Calling get_world_snapshot with the same day argument twice returns identical social_event values — confirming determinism.
For arc days 3–16, the WorldSnapshot.social_event matches the ArcPhase.social_event exactly (None when the phase has no event; the SocialEventSpec when defined on the phase).
Every non-None SocialEventSpec produced in days 17–37 has all four required fields: event_type, intensity, reciprocity, and expectedness.
A 14-day simulation run starting at day 17 detects at least one qualifying social event in the world snapshots (days 21 and 28 are expected qualifying days where 21 % 7 == 0 and 28 % 7 == 0).
A 10-day simulation run starting at day 17 (days 17–26) detects at least one qualifying social event, confirming day 21 is a qualifying day.
non_goals: Routing or filtering T4 event-aware activation by social_event.target_id.
Introducing social events for T3, T5, T6, T7, or T8 tick paths.
Modifying the AppraisalSignal schema or appraisal settlement arithmetic.
Adding social events to arc phases that do not currently define them.
UI or API changes to expose social_event to the frontend.
LLM-based or probabilistic event selection — all logic must be deterministic arithmetic on the day integer.
implementation_notes: The baseline commit (524f3c7) already contains the generator.py changes and the test file. The working tree is clean.
The executor must read back/app/world/generator.py and back/tests/test_p32_t2_world_generator_social_event.py, verify the implementation is correct, run all tests, and produce a git commit.

If the implementation in the baseline is fully correct and all tests pass, the executor should still produce a commit — for example by adding a small inline comment to generator.py documenting the Phase 32 injection trigger condition, or by ensuring the test file is final and committed.

The fallback injection trigger is: if world_day % 7 == 0, inject a qualifying SocialEventSpec. Days 21, 28, 35 qualify in the range 17–37. The event type alternates between the two _FALLBACK_QUALIFYING_EVENTS entries based on cycle_iteration.
The executor must NOT create attempt_report.json or any other file in the round directory. Only execution_evidence.json is permitted in the round directory.
